gloss: many, numerous, a great number of

definitions.gloss: many, numerous, a great number of
definitions.explanation: Emphasizes a large quantity or variety of things, often with a nuance of impressiveness or significance. Used as a noun modifier (数々の) or adverbially.

examples.japanese: {数々|かずかず}の{賞|しょう}を{受|う}けた。
{数々|かずかず}の{困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えてきた。
{彼|かれ}は{数々|かずかず}の{名作|めいさく}を{世|よ}に{送|おく}り{出|だ}した{偉大|いだい}な{作家|さっか}だ。
examples.english: He is a great author who produced numerous masterpieces.

notes:
USAGE:
{数々|かずかず} implies not just quantity but significance — it suggests an impressive collection of things. Most commonly used as {数々|かずかず}の + noun. It has a somewhat literary or formal tone and appears often in biographical or narrative contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数々|かずかず}の{実績|じっせき}: numerous achievements
- {数々|かずかず}の{困難|こんなん}: many hardships
- {数々|かずかず}の{経験|けいけん}: a wealth of experience
- {数々|かずかず}の{伝説|でんせつ}: numerous legends

SIMILAR WORDS:
- たくさん: many, a lot (casual, general-purpose)
- {多数|たすう}: a large number (formal, objective)
- {数々|かずかず}: many (literary, implies impressiveness)
